column1: # Curated chemical synonyms added by hand during verification (np9).
# np2 builds chemical_entities.synonyms from source synonym lists, which are
# incomplete: several chemicals arrive with none at all, and none of the sources
# carries the Greek-letter forms used in the primary literature. Without the
# literature form the np9 name gate cannot match a real abstract.
# Applied by np2b_synonyms.py, which is idempotent and safe to re-run after np2.
